name: linear_waveform
description: Linear waveform visualization - classic left/right channel display
script_template: (function(){var _result={};try{var comp=app.project.activeItem;if(!comp||!(comp instanceof CompItem)){_result={status:"error",message:"No active comp"};return JSON.stringify(_result)}var p={audioLayerName:"",barCount:50,barWidth:3,barGap:1,colorLeft:[0,0.8,1],colorRight:[1,0.2,0.8],amplitude:1.5};var audioLayer=p.audioLayerName?comp.layers.byName(p.audioLayerName):null;if(!audioLayer){for(var i=1;i<=comp.numLayers;i++){if(comp.layer(i).audioEnabled){audioLayer=comp.layer(i);break}}}var visLayer=comp.layers.addSolid([0,0,0],"Linear Waveform",comp.width,comp.height,1);var audioWaveform=visLayer.Effects.addProperty("ADBE Audio Waveform");if(audioLayer){audioWaveform.property("ADBE Audio Waveform-0001").setValue(audioLayer)}audioWaveform.property("ADBE Audio Waveform-0002").setValue(p.barCount);audioWaveform.property("ADBE Audio Waveform-0003").setValue(p.barWidth);audioWaveform.property("ADBE Audio Waveform-0004").setValue(p.barGap);audioWaveform.property("ADBE Audio Waveform-0005").setValue(p.colorLeft);audioWaveform.property("ADBE Audio Waveform-0006").setValue(p.colorRight);audioWaveform.property("ADBE Audio Waveform-0007").setValue([comp.width/2,comp.height/2]);audioWaveform.property("ADBE Audio Waveform-0008").setValue([comp.width,comp.height*0.6]);audioWaveform.property("ADBE Audio Waveform-0009").setValue(p.amplitude);_result={status:"success",message:"Linear waveform created"}}catch(e){_result={status:"error",message:"Error: "+e.toString()}}return JSON.stringify(_result)})();

name: particle_jump
description: Particle jump response - particles bounce with audio
script_template: (function(){var _result={};try{var comp=app.project.activeItem;if(!comp||!(comp instanceof CompItem)){_result={status:"error",message:"No active comp"};return JSON.stringify(_result)}var p={audioLayerName:"",particleCount:30,particleSize:15,color:[1,1,0],jumpHeight:150};var audioLayer=p.audioLayerName?comp.layers.byName(p.audioLayerName):null;if(!audioLayer){for(var i=1;i<=comp.numLayers;i++){if(comp.layer(i).audioEnabled){audioLayer=comp.layer(i);break}}}for(var i=0;i<p.particleCount;i++){var particle=comp.layers.addSolid(p.color,"Particle "+(i+1),p.particleSize,p.particleSize,1);particle.position.setValue([comp.width*0.1+(comp.width*0.8*i/p.particleCount),comp.height*0.8]);particle.scale.setValue([100,100]);if(audioLayer){particle.property("Position").expression="var audio=thisComp.layer(\""+audioLayer.name+"\").audioLevels;var jump=audio[0]*"+p.jumpHeight+";[value[0],value[1]-jump];";particle.property("Scale").expression="var audio=thisComp.layer(\""+audioLayer.name+"\").audioLevels[0];var scale=100+audio*50;[scale,scale];"}}_result={status:"success",message:"Particle jump created"}}catch(e){_result={status:"error",message:"Error: "+e.toString()}}return JSON.stringify(_result)})();

name: particle_scatter
description: Particle scatter response - particles scatter with audio
script_template: (function(){var _result={};try{var comp=app.project.activeItem;if(!comp||!(comp instanceof CompItem)){_result={status:"error",message:"No active comp"};return JSON.stringify(_result)}var p={audioLayerName:"",particleCount:150,particleSize:3,color:[0.8,0.8,1],scatterRadius:200};var audioLayer=p.audioLayerName?comp.layers.byName(p.audioLayerName):null;if(!audioLayer){for(var i=1;i<=comp.numLayers;i++){if(comp.layer(i).audioEnabled){audioLayer=comp.layer(i);break}}}var particleLayer=comp.layers.addSolid([0,0,0],"Particle Scatter",comp.width,comp.height,1);var ccParticle=particleLayer.Effects.addProperty("ADBE CC Particle Systems II");ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0002").setValue(p.particleCount);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0003").setValue(p.particleSize);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0004").setValue(p.color);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0005").setValue([comp.width/2,comp.height/2,0]);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0006").setValue([p.scatterRadius,p.scatterRadius,0]);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0007").setValue(100);if(audioLayer){var audioSpectrum=particleLayer.Effects.addProperty("ADBE Audio Spectrum");audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0001").setValue(audioLayer);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0006").expression="var audio=thisComp.layer(\""+audioLayer.name+"\").audioLevels[0];var scatter="+p.scatterRadius+"*(1+audio*2);[scatter,scatter,0];"}_result={status:"success",message:"Particle scatter created"}}catch(e){_result={status:"error",message:"Error: "+e.toString()}}return JSON.stringify(_result)})();

name: particle_converge

script_template: (function(){var _result={};try{var comp=app.project.activeItem;if(!comp||!(comp instanceof CompItem)){_result={status:"error",message:"No active comp"};return JSON.stringify(_result)}var p={audioLayerName:"",particleCount:200,particleSize:2,color:[0.2,1,0.5],baseRadius:300,convergeSpeed:0.8};var audioLayer=p.audioLayerName?comp.layers.byName(p.audioLayerName):null;if(!audioLayer){for(var i=1;i<=comp.numLayers;i++){if(comp.layer(i).audioEnabled){audioLayer=comp.layer(i);break}}}var particleLayer=comp.layers.addSolid([0,0,0],"Particle Converge",comp.width,comp.height,1);var ccParticle=particleLayer.Effects.addProperty("ADBE CC Particle Systems II");ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0002").setValue(p.particleCount);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0003").setValue(p.particleSize);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0004").setValue(p.color);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0005").setValue([comp.width/2,comp.height/2,0]);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0006").setValue([p.baseRadius,p.baseRadius,0]);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0007").setValue(100);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0008").setValue(0);if(audioLayer){var audioSpectrum=particleLayer.Effects.addProperty("ADBE Audio Spectrum");audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0001").setValue(audioLayer);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0006").expression="var audio=thisComp.layer(\""+audioLayer.name+"\").audioLevels[0];var radius="+p.baseRadius+"*(1-audio*"+p.convergeSpeed+");[radius,radius,0];"}_result={status:"success",message:"Particle converge created"}}catch(e){_result={status:"error",message:"Error: "+e.toString()}}return JSON.stringify(_result)})();

name: halo_pulse
description: Halo pulse response - rings pulse with audio
script_template: (function(){var _result={};try{var comp=app.project.activeItem;if(!comp||!(comp instanceof CompItem)){_result={status:"error",message:"No active comp"};return JSON.stringify(_result)}var p={audioLayerName:"",ringCount:3,baseRadius:100,color:[1,0.5,0],pulseIntensity:1.5};var audioLayer=p.audioLayerName?comp.layers.byName(p.audioLayerName):null;if(!audioLayer){for(var i=1;i<=comp.numLayers;i++){if(comp.layer(i).audioEnabled){audioLayer=comp.layer(i);break}}}for(var i=0;i<p.ringCount;i++){var ring=comp.layers.addShape();ring.name="Halo Ring "+(i+1);var grp=ring.property("Contents").addProperty("ADBE Group");var ellipse=grp.property("Contents").addProperty("ADBE Ellipse");ellipse.property("ADBE Ellipse-0001").setValue([comp.width/2,comp.height/2]);ellipse.property("ADBE Ellipse-0002").setValue([p.baseRadius*(i+1),p.baseRadius*(i+1)]);var stroke=grp.property("Contents").addProperty("ADBE Stroke");stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0001").setValue(p.color);stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0002").setValue(3);stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0003").setValue(100);var transform=grp.property("ADBE Transform Group");if(audioLayer){transform.property("ADBE Transform Group-0002").expression="var audio=thisComp.layer(\""+audioLayer.name+"\").audioLevels[0];var scale=100+audio*"+p.pulseIntensity+"*50;[scale,scale];";stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0003").expression="var audio=thisComp.layer(\""+audioLayer.name+"\").audioLevels[0];50+audio*50;"}}_result={status:"success",message:"Halo pulse created"}}catch(e){_result={status:"error",message:"Error: "+e.toString()}}return JSON.stringify(_result)})();

description: Particle waterfall - particles flow down
script_template: (function(){var _result={};try{var comp=app.project.activeItem;if(!comp||!(comp instanceof CompItem)){_result={status:"error",message:"No active comp"};return JSON.stringify(_result)}var p={audioLayerName:"",particleCount:300,particleSize:2,color:[0.3,0.6,1],speed:100};var audioLayer=p.audioLayerName?comp.layers.byName(p.audioLayerName):null;if(!audioLayer){for(var i=1;i<=comp.numLayers;i++){if(comp.layer(i).audioEnabled){audioLayer=comp.layer(i);break}}}var particleLayer=comp.layers.addSolid([0,0,0],"Particle Waterfall",comp.width,comp.height,1);var ccParticle=particleLayer.Effects.addProperty("ADBE CC Particle Systems II");ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0002").setValue(p.particleCount);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0003").setValue(p.particleSize);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0004").setValue(p.color);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0005").setValue([comp.width/2,-50,0]);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0006").setValue([comp.width,0,0]);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0007").setValue(0);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0008").setValue(p.speed);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0009").setValue(3);if(audioLayer){var audioSpectrum=particleLayer.Effects.addProperty("ADBE Audio Spectrum");audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0001").setValue(audioLayer);ccParticle.property("ADBE CC Particle Systems II-0008").expression="var audio=thisComp.layer(\""+audioLayer.name+"\").audioLevels[0];"+p.speed+"*(1+audio*2);"}_result={status:"success",message:"Particle waterfall created"}}catch(e){_result={status:"error",message:"Error: "+e.toString()}}return JSON.stringify(_result)})();

name: light_spots_flash
description: Light spots flash - spots flash with audio
script_template: (function(){var _result={};try{var comp=app.project.activeItem;if(!comp||!(comp instanceof CompItem)){_result={status:"error",message:"No active comp"};return JSON.stringify(_result)}var p={audioLayerName:"",spotCount:25,spotSize:20,color:[1,0.8,0],flashThreshold:0.3};var audioLayer=p.audioLayerName?comp.layers.byName(p.audioLayerName):null;if(!audioLayer){for(var i=1;i<=comp.numLayers;i++){if(comp.layer(i).audioEnabled){audioLayer=comp.layer(i);break}}}for(var i=0;i<p.spotCount;i++){var spot=comp.layers.addSolid(p.color,"Light Spot "+(i+1),p.spotSize,p.spotSize,1);spot.position.setValue([Math.random()*comp.width,Math.random()*comp.height]);spot.opacity.setValue(0);spot.scale.setValue([50+Math.random()*50,50+Math.random()*50]);var glow=spot.Effects.addProperty("ADBE Glo2i");glow.property("ADBE Glo2i-0001").setValue(p.color);glow.property("ADBE Glo2i-0002").setValue(15);if(audioLayer){spot.opacity.expression="var audio=thisComp.layer(\""+audioLayer.name+"\").audioLevels[0];audio>"+p.flashThreshold+"?100:0;"}}_result={status:"success",message:"Light spots flash created"}}catch(e){_result={status:"error",message:"Error: "+e.toString()}}return JSON.stringify(_result)})();

name: wave_amplitude
description: Wave amplitude - continuous wave display
script_template: (function(){var _result={};try{var comp=app.project.activeItem;if(!comp||!(comp instanceof CompItem)){_result={status:"error",message:"No active comp"};return JSON.stringify(_result)}var p={audioLayerName:"",waveCount:3,waveHeight:150,color:[0.5,0.8,1],speed:2.0};var audioLayer=p.audioLayerName?comp.layers.byName(p.audioLayerName):null;if(!audioLayer){for(var i=1;i<=comp.numLayers;i++){if(comp.layer(i).audioEnabled){audioLayer=comp.layer(i);break}}}for(var i=0;i<p.waveCount;i++){var wave=comp.layers.addShape();wave.name="Wave "+(i+1);var grp=wave.property("Contents").addProperty("ADBE Group");var path=grp.property("Contents").addProperty("ADBE Path");var points=[];for(var j=0;j<=100;j++){var x=j/100*comp.width;var y=comp.height/2+Math.sin(j/10*Math.PI*2+i*Math.PI*2/p.waveCount)*p.waveHeight/2;points.push([x,y])}path.setValue(points);var stroke=grp.property("Contents").addProperty("ADBE Stroke");stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0001").setValue(p.color);stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0002").setValue(3);if(audioLayer){stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0003").expression="var audio=thisComp.layer(\""+audioLayer.name+"\").audioLevels[0];50+audio*50;"}}_result={status:"success",message:"Wave amplitude created"}}catch(e){_result={status:"error",message:"Error: "+e.toString()}}return JSON.stringify(_result)})();

name: energy_rings
description: Energy rings - expanding rings with audio
script_template: (function(){var _result={};try{var comp=app.project.activeItem;if(!comp||!(comp instanceof CompItem)){_result={status:"error",message:"No active comp"};return JSON.stringify(_result)}var p={audioLayerName:"",ringCount:4,baseRadius:80,color:[1,0.2,0.6],expansionSpeed:150};var audioLayer=p.audioLayerName?comp.layers.byName(p.audioLayerName):null;if(!audioLayer){for(var i=1;i<=comp.numLayers;i++){if(comp.layer(i).audioEnabled){audioLayer=comp.layer(i);break}}}for(var i=0;i<p.ringCount;i++){var ring=comp.layers.addShape();ring.name="Energy Ring "+(i+1);var grp=ring.property("Contents").addProperty("ADBE Group");var ellipse=grp.property("Contents").addProperty("ADBE Ellipse");ellipse.property("ADBE Ellipse-0001").setValue([comp.width/2,comp.height/2]);ellipse.property("ADBE Ellipse-0002").setValue([p.baseRadius,p.baseRadius]);var stroke=grp.property("Contents").addProperty("ADBE Stroke");stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0001").setValue(p.color);stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0002").setValue(2);stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0003").setValue(100);var transform=grp.property("ADBE Transform Group");transform.property("ADBE Transform Group-0002").setValue([100,100]);var startTime=i*0.5;transform.property("ADBE Transform Group-0002").setKeyAtTime(startTime);transform.property("ADBE Transform Group-0002").setValueAtTime(startTime+2,[400,400]);transform.property("ADBE Transform Group-0002").setInterpolationTypeAtKey(startTime,KeyframeInterpolationType.LINEAR);transform.property("ADBE Transform Group-0002").setInterpolationTypeAtKey(startTime+2,KeyframeInterpolationType.LINEAR);stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0003").setKeyAtTime(startTime);stroke.property("ADBE Stroke-0003").setValueAtTime(startTime+2,0)}_result={status:"success",message:"Energy rings created"}}catch(e){_result={status:"error",message:"Error: "+e.toString()}}return JSON.stringify(_result)})();

name: frequency_bars_3d
description: 3D frequency bars - 3D rotating spectrum
script_template: (function(){var _result={};try{var comp=app.project.activeItem;if(!comp||!(comp instanceof CompItem)){_result={status:"error",message:"No active comp"};return JSON.stringify(_result)}var p={audioLayerName:"",barCount:18,barWidth:20,color:[0.8,0.8,1],rotationSpeed:0.3};var audioLayer=p.audioLayerName?comp.layers.byName(p.audioLayerName):null;if(!audioLayer){for(var i=1;i<=comp.numLayers;i++){if(comp.layer(i).audioEnabled){audioLayer=comp.layer(i);break}}}var visLayer=comp.layers.addSolid([0,0,0],"3D Frequency Bars",comp.width,comp.height,1);visLayer.threeDLayer=true;var audioSpectrum=visLayer.Effects.addProperty("ADBE Audio Spectrum");if(audioLayer){audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0001").setValue(audioLayer)}audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0002").setValue(p.barCount);audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0003").setValue(p.barWidth);audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0005").setValue(p.color);audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0006").setValue(p.color);audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0007").setValue([comp.width/2,comp.height/2]);audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0008").setValue([comp.width*0.8,comp.height*0.5]);audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0009").setValue(1.5);audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0011").setValue(0);audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0012").setValue(360);audioSpectrum.property("ADBE Audio Spectrum-0014").setValue(0);visLayer.property("Y Rotation").expression="time*"+p.rotationSpeed+"*360";if(!comp.activeCamera){var cam=comp.layers.addCamera();cam.property("Point of Interest").setValue([comp.width/2,comp.height/2,0]);cam.property("Position").setValue([comp.width/2,comp.height/2,600])}_result={status:"success",message:"3D frequency bars created"}}catch(e){_result={status:"error",message:"Error: "+e.toString()}}return JSON.stringify(_result)})();
